sentence: This project provides laboratory tests and services that help scientists study single cells and the virus that causes AIDS.
This project builds a tool that uses artificial intelligence to help review boards find gaps, errors and ethical risks in study protocols.
This project studies how fatty acid production and the cell parts that break down waste affect brain tumor stem cells.
This project studies how cells divide and repair their outer membrane, using fission yeast as a model.
This project uses machine learning and clinical data to predict which people with a traumatic brain injury will develop epilepsy.
This project teaches researchers how to use machine learning to measure animal behavior automatically.
This project builds analysis methods to search cancer sequencing data for non-coding RNAs that drive cancer.
This project studies how emotion processing and anxiety change in early Alzheimer's disease and who is at risk of cognitive decline.
This project studies how cells repair double-strand breaks in DNA and how the repair proteins are controlled.
This project studies how genetic variation affects who gets osteoarthritis and how the disease differs and progresses.
This project studies how compounds act against methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus bacteria that are inactive and tolerate conventional antibiotics.
This project studies the molecular and cellular reasons why some people aged 90 and above keep thinking well despite Alzheimer's disease.
This project studies the shape of a serotonin receptor in membranes and searches for compounds that change how it works.
This project provides data management and statistical analysis to help predict which people with a sleep disorder go on to develop a brain disease.
This project uses statistical modeling to link activity in small groups of brain cells that release dopamine to wider brain networks.
This project tests whether iron supplements taken by mouth before spinal fusion surgery help adolescents with scoliosis avoid problems such as blood transfusion.
This project builds mass spectrometry tools to study ribosomes and other large molecular assemblies that differ from one another.
This project builds a tool that uses artificial intelligence and biopsy images to predict how well a transplanted kidney will work.
This project provides mouse models, tumor testing and tissue analysis services for cancer research.
This project uses CRISPR genome editing to make genetically engineered mice and cell lines for cancer research.
